metadata.description: A phased workflow system for Claude Code: converse, plan, execute, finalize. One branch per plan, on a branch or inside a git worktree.

plugins.name: wf
plugins.description: Phased development workflow with natural conversation planning, one phase per session, one branch and one commit per phase, and a self-correcting autonomous chain (convergence loops + fresh-eyes repair)

plugins.name: wf-bar
plugins.description: The phased workflow's buttons above the prompt: the next step — /wf:execute-phase on the phase's model and effort, after clearing the worker — and ☰ wf, a palette of every user command, the ones that fit now highlighted; in the foreman chat too. A Claude Code mod: needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later with mods turned on, and the wf plugin.
